propositions: Write-op input surfaces (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across lib/CLI/MCP adapters with no mechanical guard against drift, causing silent param omissions between transports.

A durable pytest conformance oracle executes a single shared contract table across all three adapters against fresh temp stores, classifying each row as ACCEPTED/REJECTED(rule)/PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED and failing on any divergence.
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be asserted behaviorally across every adapter, not shape-generated.

MCP gaps on transition/claim (reason, caused_by, force not exposed in inputSchema) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, keeping the suite green in CI until those params are added.
Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) must not register as false divergences in the contract.
The oracle detects convergence: a closed gap flips a strict-xfail row to xpass in-suite, forcing marker removal as the signal to clean up.
